text: ささると　どくで　きをうしなう。

structure.jp: どくで　きをうしなう。

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. ささると = 'if it sticks in'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing can show what causes the result. どくで = 'because of the poison'.
